verdicts.reason: A: the canvas edge cuts off the tops and bottoms of the plan cards, which have also been turned into ovals. The subhead sits to the left of the headline, so it is read first and the reading order is wrong. The legal text is squeezed into a cramped column between the CTA and the cards, and the logo is tiny and floats on its own. B is better: the headline clearly dominates, and the logo-headline-cards-CTA flow reads left to right. Its flaws: the price cards are shrunk so far that MONTHLY/FAMILY and 'per month' can't be read, the cards are out of their original order (6, 80, 48), and the subhead and legal text are crammed against the right edge and the bottom of the banner.
